title: Be a registered general auctioneer
what: Carry on general auctioneering business only as a registered general auctioneer (or real estate agent).

laws.title: Property Agents and Land Transactions Act 2016 (Tas)

sources.title: Property Agents and Land Transactions Act 2016 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on all or any part of general auctioneering business or hold himself or herself out as prepared to do so unless the person is a general auctioneer named in Part 3(1) of the Register or a real estate agent named in Part 1(1) of the Register
